results.title: Google Pixel 4a boot loop bug finally fixed after 2 months
results.description: Google Pixel 4a users had a rough time, because after Google intentionally cut the battery life of many Pixel 4a devices in half via a software update, the smartphone became nearly unusable in some cases due to a boot loop issue. The July update finally fixes this bug.
